newsitem.title: USA: WICOR unit settles swimming pool lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: WICOR unit settles swimming pool lawsuit.

text.p: WICOR Inc said Tuesday its Sta-Rite Industries division agreed to settle a lawsuit related to a 1993 swimming pool entrapment accident for $25 million, the amount awarded by a jury January 13.
The accident, at a public pool in Raleigh, N.C., involved an improperly installed pool drain cover made by Sta-Rite in 1987, the company said.

"This was a terribly tragic accident," Sta-Rite President and Chief Executive Officer James Donnelly said. "However we also believe Sta-Rite was not responsible for what happened. Proper use of our product would have prevented the accident."
Donnelly said the company's liability insurance will cover most of the settlement.
WICOR makes pumps and water processing equipment.
